title: Senior AI Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Senior Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years building LLM-powered production applications and classical ML across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs agentic systems in LangGraph and LangChain, RAG and multi-agent architectures, with automated evaluations, success metrics, tracing and failure detection. Brings MLOps practice with MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, fine-tuning with PyTorch, and strong data intuition from log analysis and anomaly detection on network KPIs. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: IT Issue Triage Agent
bullets: Built a multi-agent assistant that inspects endpoint and application logs, retrieves past fixes with RAG and proposes remediation steps for employee IT issues before tickets pile up.
Evaluated answers with automated LLM evaluations and regression metrics in a CI pipeline, versioned prompt and embedding configs in MLflow, and deployed the service on AWS with Docker.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior AI Machine Learning Engineer role on the AI Agents team. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, I design agentic LLM systems and the evaluation and MLOps work that keeps them reliable in production. My background in AIOps, where I spent years reading network logs and alarms, is what ties it all together.

Nexthink helps IT teams find and fix problems before employees notice them, which is very close to the anomaly detection and root-cause work I did for telecom networks. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Switzerland together and settle in Lausanne for the long term.

I would bring agents that are measured, not guessed at. In my current role I built evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators and tracing that cut human review by 43%. At Viavi I shipped an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that used GPT-3.5 for root-cause analysis and reduced downtime by 67%.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building it has taught me to design for people who have no patience for tools that break. I would be glad to discuss how I could contribute to your AI Agents team.
